description: This donut chart illustrates the distribution of a "Task Type," as denoted by the bolded text located in the center hole of the ring. The chart is divided into a total of two slices, which are visually ordered by descending size. The largest segment is colored light red, occupying the majority of the ring, and is labeled "Article generation (83.2%)" just outside the left side of the chart. The second, notably smaller segment is colored pale yellow and is labeled "Headline generation (16.8%)" just outside the bottom right. The chart does not utilize a separate legend or place percentage labels inside the slices themselves; instead, all descriptive labels and their corresponding exact percentages are positioned alongside their respective segments. There are no visually emphasized segments, such as exploded or offset slices, though the central title text is bolded for prominence.
